name: nested_object_decode_field_order
description: A nested object decoded from an expanded section must preserve the order its key=value lines appear (z,a,m), not sort them. A decoder that rebuilds the nested object into an unordered map re-encodes lexicographically (a,m,z) and fails the round-trip. Object key ordering is a preserved round-trip property (SPEC lines 52, 931).
expected:
GCF profile=generic
## outer
  z=1
  a=2
  m=3
